answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism for AI agents by requiring capital commitment to secure the network ledge. An attacker attempting to flood the system must acquire a significant delta of total token supply to influence consensus outcomes. This economic barrier functions like a sparrow in a storm, remaining agile but bound to the underlying asset value; the cost of creating fake identities is thus proportional to the capital staked, rendering Sybil attacks prohibitively expensive.
